item.title: Nine Months as a Student Again
item.author: Vamshi Krishna Reddy Bandaru
item.description: I completed the UT Austin McCombs Post Graduate Program in AI & Machine Learning on top of a full consulting load — nine months, nine projects, A+ in six of seven core modules. Here is what it actually cost, what changed, and what I'd tell my past self.
